remarks: Exceptional space inside and out! The four distinct levels offer plenty of room for entertaining, relaxing, working from home or pursuing hobbies. Outside, the expansive lot provides wonderful space for gardening, outdoor gatherings and recreation. Located in an established Mill Woods neighbourhood with convenient access to schools, parks, shopping, public transit and major commuter routes. An outstanding combination of size, flexibility and outdoor space! (id:67522)
